nodes.name: Finish Webhook
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 7: the session-waiter's finish callback entry. The external waiter POSTs the terminal session result here (outcome, output_blocks, usage, carry-state). headerAuth (X-Watchdog-Key, shared waiter<->n8n key) — n8n /webhook/* is public via nginx, and this posts ClickUp comments + flips status with the bot token, so it MUST be authed. Idempotent on session_id (Claim Finish). Path: session-waiter-finish (matches Post Handoff to Waiter's finish_callback_url).

nodes.name: Claim Finish
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 7 idempotency key. Atomic claim: flip the row to 'finished' ONLY from a not-yet-finished status, RETURNING the row. Exactly one callback wins the claim (returns a row -> publish); a duplicate/retry callback matches 0 rows -> Respond idempotent skip (no double-post). The waiter sets status='delivered'/'failed' before POSTing, so this transitions delivered/failed/handed_off/running -> finished. handed_off_at is returned as the per-execution image-cost window (since_ts). alwaysOutputData so a 0-row claim still yields an item for the IF.

parameters.query:
update waiter_sessions
set status = 'finished', finished_at = now()
where session_id = $1 and status <> 'finished'
returning session_id, clickup_task_id, handed_off_at, surface;

nodes.name: Claimed?
nodes.notes: TRUE = we won the claim (row returned) -> publish. FALSE = 0 rows (already finished / duplicate callback) -> Respond idempotent skip.

nodes.name: Respond Skip
nodes.notes: Idempotent no-op: the session was already finished (duplicate/retried callback). 200 so the waiter stops retrying.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, idempotent_skip: true, session_id: $('Finish Webhook').first().json.body.session_id } }}

nodes.name: Get Anthropic Key
nodes.notes: ADR-066 A6: the managed key for the Files API doc listing (SECURITY DEFINER Vault getter, migration 034). Never stored on the row; fetched fresh here. Same source as Post Reply (v1) Get Doc Key.

nodes.name: Build Result
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 7: compute doc_files (Files API) + usd_cost + cost_impact + consolidated warnings from the waiter callback. Ports the cost math + doc-MIME map from execute-agent-session 'Build Final Output' (KEEP IN SYNC). Emits do_alert/_sev/_msg/_details for the consolidated degradation alert (NOT the non-delivery CRITICAL — Publish fires that).

nodes.name: Log Session Cost
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 7: log ONE priced agent_runs row via Log Model Run (v1) (sole FX/PLN owner) BEFORE Publish, so Publish's Write Cost Field task SUM includes this session. Passes the pre-computed usd_cost so Log Model Run uses it verbatim. Returns cost_pln_total -> Publish's comment footer (per-execution cost). onError=continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData so a cost-log hiccup never blocks publishing.

nodes.name: Call Publish Managed Result
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 7: the SAME shared Publish Managed Result (v1) the sync orchestrator calls — gate (Session OK?) -> render -> cost-field -> Post Reply Managed / Incomplete + Alert Non-Delivery. Builds the normalized contract from the waiter payload + Build Result (doc_files/usd status) + Log Session Cost (cost_pln) + Claim Finish (handed_off_at = image-cost window). input_image_refs_json='[]' (no re-assembled context; only re-embedded existing task attachments would degrade, with a WARN).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, published: true, session_id: $('Finish Webhook').first().json.body.session_id, status: $('Build Result').first().json.status } }}

nodes.name: Should Alert?
nodes.notes: Consolidated degradation alert (side branch off Build Result, never blocks Respond). TRUE when Build Result flagged do_alert (session-level warnings: doc-list-failed / cost-* / deliver-output-empty / tool-bridge / clickup-scope).

nodes.name: Post Alert
nodes.notes: Centralized Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025). One consolidated WARN/CRITICAL for the session-level degradations. onError=continueRegularOutput so an alert hiccup never breaks the finish run.
